name: bengali-arc-c-2.5k
description: A Bengali-language benchmark derived from the ARC (AI2 Reasoning Challenge) dataset containing ~2.5k multiple-choice science questions in Bengali. It measures a model's ability to understand domain-specific questions, retrieve relevant knowledge, and perform multi-step reasoning in Bengali. Suited for evaluating multilingual QA and reasoning capabilities on grade-school science content.
reputation: A localized variant of the well-known ARC benchmark used within Indic NLP research; moderately recognized in the community but not as widely adopted as English ARC.
